ctx.x: But the fellow who owned the club at that time, Felix Young, asked Lena could -- he says -- well, like most clubs they have a room for the band boys, you know,

and of course everybody during intermission time, when they'd take their intermission, we all sat in the band room. Well, you know how the musicians are, the guys are talking and cracking and making jokes and whatever. So Felix said -- he says, "Listen, I'm going to ask Miss Horne if it'll be all right for you to sit in her dressing room. Would it be all right with you if I asked her?"
